edit.description: the base checkout comes from the api; its own worktree plumbing goes
the base run over an engine-supplied checkout, driven inside a gate checkout scope

summary: The vitest runner's base run takes its detached checkout from the engine instead of provisioning its own
acceptance: `runAtBase` adds and removes no worktree of its own — the checkout is the API's and the engine reclaims it.
tests: runAtBase takes its base checkout from the engine's api rather than adding a worktree
notes: `checkoutAt` refuses outside a gate scope, but runtime is already scoped: `namedLinesGate` (harness/chain.ts) runs through `Dispatcher.runGate`, which opens `withGateCheckouts`. The prior attempt reverted because tests/harnessRunner.test.ts drives `runAtBase` directly — wrap those drives in `withGateCheckouts` (src/worktrees.ts), no new seam. The addWorktree/removeWorktree/base-join block at harness/vitestRunner.ts:248-295 is what leaves; adopting also reaches the chain-declared base.

edit.description: the gate checkout scope carries the namespace; `checkoutAt` plants under it
hand the namespace to `withGateCheckouts` beside the declared base
the planted path under a namespaced job

summary: A differential gate's checkout plants under the job namespace, where the startup sweep actually reads

per.section: Placement — the worktree base and the job namespace

acceptance: Under a job namespace, `checkoutAt` plants at `<base>/<ns>/…` — the level `sweepStaleWorktrees` scans — so a run killed mid-gate leaves reclaimable residue.
tests: a namespaced job's checkoutAt plants under the namespace directory the startup sweep reads
notes: `checkoutAt` plants at the bare `worktreesBase`; `sweepStaleWorktrees` scans `<base>/<ns>` when namespaced, so the residue `checkoutAt`'s own doc promises is reclaimed is never read. The scope `withGateCheckouts` opens already carries one dispatcher-known value (`declaredWorktreesBase`) — the namespace is `this.opts.namespace` at the same call site, src/Dispatcher.ts:3902. Bites under a shared FLUME_WORKTREES_DIR.
